svg.title: Visual feedback during a task: GameDevBench

cc:Work.dc:title: Visual feedback during a task: GameDevBench
cc:Work.dc:description: Redrawn from Chi et al., GameDevBench, arXiv 2602.11103v2, Table 2. GPT-5.4 in the Codex harness: pass@1 rises from 41.1% without screenshot or video to 52.0% with screenshot and runtime-video tools, a 10.9 percentage-point increase. This changes observations during inference, not model training; inference costs differ. The axis runs from 0 to 100 percent. No uncertainty interval is reported for these rows.
